senses.gloss: m. h. a. ch. (שָׁרַר) [tied; cmp. כָּשֵׁר,] strong, fast, reliable, fit, proper.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Deuteronomy 33:29">Targ. Y. II, Deut. XXXIII, 29</cite> (not <cite ref="U01966"><he>שריד</he></cite>; h. text <he>אשר</he>!).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 19:7">Targ. Prov. XIX, 7</cite> (h. text <he>המה</he>!).—
<cite ref="Shabbat 145b:13">Sabb. 145ᵇ</cite> <he>לא ש׳ שדריה</he> its spinal column is not strong enough.
Pes. 74ᵇ בחיורתא דש׳ in the case of dough of white flour, which is bound (compact).—Esp. in the closing formula of a document: ש׳ וקים fit and established.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 160b:18">B. Bath. 160ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 9:8:2">Y. Gitt. IX, 50ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>קיים ש׳ וברור</he> established, fit, and sound.—Pl. <he>שְׁרִירַיָּיא</he>; f. <he>שְׁרִירָן</he>.
<cite ref="Targum of II Chronicles 5:10">Targ. II Chr. V, 10</cite> <he>ש׳</he> (not <he>שריד׳</he>) the sound tables (opp. <he>כד אתברו</he> the broken).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 8:9">Targ. Y. I Deut. VIII, 9</cite> <he>גזרן ש׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>בריר׳</he>).
